none: PAS PAS-713571: Water Newton: Roman lead curse tablet
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A possible Roman curse tablet made of a folded sheet of lead. It has been perforated after folding with 2 holes and has an incised rectangular pattern broken into 4 segments. This pattern has been further subdivided by the incising of diagonal lines across the segments to produce 4 triangles in each. The other side has two rows of incised dots and a line parallel to the edge. This object measures…
